title: Momentum Monday
summary: Focus on winning the next point rather than winning the match. Prompts: How are you feeling (1-10)? How can I get that score up by the end of the week? What are your three main goals for the week? What actions am I going to take to make them happen? What actions will I take to start the week strong? A promise I'm making myself. What am I excited for this week?

title: Talking Tuesday
summary: Strengthen connection. Prompts: Who have I not spoken to in a while that I should reach out to? Who deserves a shout-out or a thank you? Is there a conversation I need to have with someone? Is there anyone I can get in touch with to help me? Tell at least one friend or family member you love them. What's one hard thing I can do that I will benefit from?

title: Workout Wednesday
summary: Movement is medicine. Track running PB (current/target) and gym exercise PB (current/target). Prompts: What exercise am I doing today? How does my body feel today (physically and mentally)? How has my exercise been this week? What exercise do I have planned for the rest of the week? Do I want to improve anything from exercise both physically and mentally?

title: Thursday Thoughts
summary: A moment to pause, reflect and learn (carries a rotating weekly quote). Prompts: How is this week going? What has gone well this week? What emotions have I felt most this week? What did this week teach me? What has helped me this week? What would make today a win? What did I do yesterday that I'm proud of? What's one thing I've been avoiding that I know would make my life better if I finally got it done?

title: Feel Good Friday
summary: Ending the week on a positive. Prompts: Did you achieve your goals from Monday (yes/partially/no)? What went well? What can I do better next week? What are your three big wins for the week? What am I most proud of this week? What is the most fun I've had this week? What are my plans for the weekend? How good do I feel today (1-10)? Random act of kindness - what did I do today? Give someone a compliment - who and what did I say?

title: Set Up Sunday
summary: Prepare with intention, then fully switch off. Prompts: What can I plan or prepare to set up a good start to Monday? Is there one task I can do which will make Monday feel easier? Now, relax and enjoy your Sunday.

title: Morning Routine
summary: Win the morning, win the day. How did I sleep (1-10)? Stay off your phone for 30 minutes in the morning. Hydration - a large glass of water BEFORE your morning coffee. Checklist: morning walk, breath work, cold dip/shower. Power List - write the day's priority tasks.

title: Night Time Routine
summary: Reflect, reset and prepare for a better tomorrow. Checklist: no phone one hour before bed, hot bath/shower. Gratitude - what's the one thing I'm grateful for today? Highlight - what was the highlight of my day? Reflection - rate my day (1-10). Looking ahead - what am I looking forward to tomorrow? Tomorrow is a new day, rest up and go again.

title: STAND Fundamentals Checklist
summary: Your daily non-negotiables. Daily ticks: Hydration (water), Step count, Alcohol free, Healthy food. STAND: S - Strength of connection (who did I connect with and talk to?); T - Try new things, learn and develop (what did I learn today?); A - Active lifestyle (what physical activity have I done today?); N - Notice the more, be present (what have I noticed today?); D - Do good for others (what have I done/given someone?).

title: The Law of Conformity
summary: Environment will always trump willpower. We adapt to the environment around us and become like the people we spend the most time with. Build an environment that challenges, holds you accountable, celebrates your growth, inspires, educates and supports you. You don't rise to the level of your goals - you fall to the level of your environment. Choose it on purpose.

title: The Law of Polarity
summary: The opposites always exist - struggle/victory, storms/sunshine, pain/joy. Nothing is permanent, including the bad times (Romans 8:18). If you're in a dark headspace, keep going - there will be light. Embrace both sides of life; they shape you. This season won't last. The good times are coming.

title: Movement Changes Mindset
summary: Feel stuck? Move. After 20 minutes of walking the brain shows increased blood flow, oxygen and activity in areas linked to focus, mood and emotional regulation. Movement increases focus, boosts energy, improves mood, reduces stress and creates mental clarity. Move your body, clear your mind, strengthen your life.

title: Doing Hard Things Changes Your Brain
summary: Research from Andrew Huberman: choosing difficult tasks strengthens the brain systems for focus, stress tolerance and decision-making through neuroplasticity. Hard things that support mental health: exercise, cold exposure, hard conversations, keeping routines, setting boundaries, doing what you've been avoiding, sitting with discomfort, showing up when it's hard.

title: The Law of Attraction
summary: You attract what you focus on, think about and feel most deeply (Matthew 7:7). Focus on what you want, not what you don't. Energy flows where attention goes. The cycle: focus, visualise, feel, believe, attract, receive. What you focus on expands.

title: Physiological Sigh & Box Breathing
summary: One of the fastest ways to reduce anxiety or panic in the moment. Physiological Sigh: inhale through the nose, short top-up inhale, slow exhale through the mouth, repeat up to 10 times. Box Breathing: inhale 4, hold 4, exhale 4, hold 4, repeat for 1-3 minutes.

title: Weekly Review
summary: Reflect, learn and reset for the week ahead. Prompts: What habits served me this week? What challenges helped me grow? What lessons did I learn this week? What challenges did I overcome and what did they teach me? Do I feel better for sticking to my positive habits? What's one thing I can improve on going forward? Which habits am I going to double down on to continue the momentum?

title: 30 Day Review
summary: Reflect, reset, refocus. Top 5 wins. Looking back: what am I most proud of, which habits helped most, what challenges have I overcome. What's working? What needs to change (what's holding me back)? Self-assessment 1-10: mindset, energy, discipline, relationships, confidence, overall progress. Next 30-day focus. Commitment statement + sign/date.

title: 60 Day Review
summary: Reflect, adjust, strengthen. What progress since day one? What challenges have I overcome? Biggest wins (top 5). What have I learned about myself? Identity check: who am I becoming? Self-assessment 1-10: mental wellbeing, physical health, confidence, consistency, relationships, purpose. Next 30-day focus. Commitment statement + sign/date.

title: 90 Day Review
summary: Reflect, celebrate, grow. You made a promise and kept it. Looking back: how has my mindset changed, what have I learned, what still needs work. Top 10 wins. Looking forward: habits to continue, next 3 goals, one promise to myself. Gratitude. Rate the last 90 days (1-10) across 8 areas. Final reflection + a letter to myself.

title: Welcome & Philosophy
summary: Your happiness depends on the quality of your thoughts (Marcus Aurelius). Questions are the steering wheel to our thoughts - this journal focuses them on the positives. The mind needs training just as much as the body: mental fitness. You can't build a house without foundations - do the fundamentals consistently. A 90-day plan. Don't try to win the match, just win the next point - just win the day.

title: Vision Board & Hot Pen
summary: Write down everything you want from life - go big, no limits, no judgement. Use a HOT PEN technique: do not stop writing for ten minutes. Then create a visual vision board (pictures, goals, quotes, places, words, reminders, people, feelings, dreams) and place it somewhere you'll see it every single day. Your mind goes where your focus goes.

title: 90 Day Plan of Attack
summary: Why won't I throw in the towel - when motivation fades, this is the reason I'll keep going. Key milestones: day 30, day 60, day 90. My five non-negotiables. My commitment to myself: I commit to showing up for myself over the next 90 days. I will not be perfect, but I will not quit. Sign and date.
